items.title: Brenda Song Says She Was ‘Overworked’ and ‘Underpaid’ on ‘The Suite Life of Zack and Cody,’ Recalls Fainting on Set: I Thought, ‘Am I Having a Panic Attack?’
items.title_zh: Brenda Song说她在《扎克和科迪的套房生活》中“工作过度”和“报酬不足” ，回忆起在片场晕倒：我想， “我是不是惊恐发作？”
items.summary: Brenda Song recently revealed that she felt she was “overworked” and “underpaid” while starring on “The Suite Life of Zack and Cody.” The “Running Point” actress opened up about her experience working on the Disney Channel sitcom while appearing on her former co-star Dylan…
items.summary_zh: Brenda Song最近透露，她在主演“The Suite Life of Zack and Cody”时感到“过度劳累”和“报酬不足”。这位“Running Point”女演员公开了她在迪士尼频道情景喜剧中工作的经历，同时出现在她的前联合主演迪伦身上……

items.title: Stacy Keach, Star of ‘Mike Hammer,’ ‘Fat City,’ Dies at 85
items.title_zh: Stacy Keach ， “Mike Hammer” ， “Fat City”的明星， 85岁去世
items.summary: Stacy Keach, a commanding actor whose work includes movies like “Fat City” and the starring role in “The New Mike Hammer” series on CBS, died Tuesday in Poland. He was 85. His wife, Małgosia Tomassi, confirmed his death to Variety.
items.summary_zh: Stacy Keach是一名指挥演员，其作品包括“Fat City”等电影以及哥伦比亚广播公司“The New Mike Hammer”系列中的主演角色，于周二在波兰去世。他当时85岁。他的妻子Małgosia Tomassi向Variety证实了他的死讯。

items.title: X launches its own clipping feature to spur influencer engagement
items.title_zh: X推出自己的剪辑功能，以激发网红的参与度
items.summary: X is jumping into clipping, the popular practice of cutting long videos into short, shareable clips that can go viral.
items.summary_zh: X正在跳入剪辑，这是一种流行的做法，将长视频剪辑成可以传播的短片，可共享的剪辑。

items.title: Microsoft’s DLSS competitor is out for the Xbox Ally X and works in handheld mode
items.title_zh: 微软的DLSS竞争对手推出了Xbox Ally X ，并以手持模式工作
items.summary: Microsoft is now rolling out Automatic Super Resolution (Auto SR), an upscaling technology that competes with Nvidia's DLSS, for the Xbox Ally X, Xbox Ally X20, and select Windows Copilot Plus PCs, the company announced today.
items.summary_zh: 微软今天宣布，微软正在推出自动超分辨率（ Auto SR ） ，这是一种与英伟达DLSS竞争的升级技术，适用于Xbox Ally X、Xbox Ally X20和精选的Windows Copilot Plus PC。

items.title: Attempt to impeach Trump's defence secretary blocked
items.title_zh: 试图弹劾特朗普的国防部长被阻止
items.summary: An attempt to impeach US defence secretary Pete Hegseth has been blocked following a vote in the House of Representatives on Tuesday.
items.summary_zh: 在周二众议院投票后，弹劾美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯（ Pete Hegseth ）的企图被阻止。

items.title: Hegseth impeachment effort torpedoed in House
items.title_zh: 赫格塞特的弹劾努力在众议院遭到破坏
items.summary: GOP Rep. Thomas Massie, who has clashed with President Donald Trump, kicked off the Hegseth impeachment fight days after a blue wave midterm election.
items.summary_zh: 与唐纳德·特朗普总统发生冲突的共和党众议员托马斯·马西（ Thomas Massie ）在蓝色浪潮中期选举几天后开始了赫格塞斯弹劾之战。

items.title: Jim Cramer says Anthropic's explosive growth could justify a record-breaking IPO
items.title_zh: Jim Cramer表示， Anthropic的爆炸性增长可能证明破纪录的IPO是合理的
items.summary: "The fact that this deal is on is bullish for tech and the AI trade," CNBC's Jim Cramer said Tuesday.
items.summary_zh: “这笔交易正在进行的事实看好科技和人工智能交易，” CNBC的吉姆·克莱默(Jim Cramer)周二表示。

items.title: CoreWeave beats on revenue and lifts guidance, easing AI slowdown concerns
items.title_zh: CoreWeave击败收入和提升指引，缓解人工智能放缓的担忧
items.summary: CoreWeave's stock has been hammered heading into the neocloud's Q3 earnings report.
items.summary_zh: CoreWeave的股票已被纳入新云的第三季度收益报告。

items.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
items.title_zh: OpenAI收购由Sonder创始人创建的旅游创业公司Odessia
items.summary: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI尚未说明其对未来旅行的计划。但Sonder创始人弗朗西斯·戴维森（ Francis Davidson ）是旅游业的知名人物。

items.title: Ex-investigator admits depriving war crimes probe of potentially valuable information
items.title_zh: 前调查员承认剥夺了战争罪调查潜在有价值的信息
items.summary: A former senior investigating officer for the Royal Military Police has admitted depriving a war crimes investigation of potentially valuable information.
items.summary_zh: 皇家军事警察局的一名前高级调查官承认剥夺了战争罪调查的潜在有价值的信息。
